audit.notes: Perfect match for the creator's b-roll library. Simply assemble clips of working on a laptop, bouldering at the climbing gym, walking around NYC, and hanging out with friends, paired with the animated beat-synced text overlay.
audit.summary: A montage of lifestyle b-roll clips showcasing effort, climbing, studying, and creative hobbies, arguing that taking easy shortcuts like ChatGPT robs life of meaning and personal growth.
